messages:
support-bot: ALERT: multiple customers reporting p95/p99 spikes for text-generation endpoints in us-west-2 since 09:12 UTC. Tickets: #3201 #3202. p95 up ~250-400ms, p99 up ~750ms. rolling alert from infra-monitor :rotating_light:
jamie: ACK, looking. which model/routes? any recent deploys?
deepak: seeing KV cache miss rate jump to 91% on pool=rw-gpu-r3, prefixcache.evictions spiked at 09:07. heatmap shows hotset churn.
sara: we shipped key-normalization change to production at 08:50 (PR 786). It changes prefix hashing to include user_id shard.
luis: that PR increased effective cardinality for some customers (we saw sample tests fail in staging but not caught).
michael: can we repro with replay of recent traffic? support-bot: attached request samples for #3201 in ticket.
jamie: running local repro against a small pool now, will run with /metrics view to confirm miss-rate behaviour.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: diff rolled: prod/service/runtime v2.13.1 -> v2.13.2 by sara at 08:50 UTC.
jamie: quick check: Grafana query shows prefixcache_miss_rate{region="us-west-2"} jumped from 12% -> 88% between 09:05-09:12. p95 latency correlates with miss spikes.
deepak: looking at eviction logs, eviction_reason="key_entropy" flagged a lot. suspect normalization increased key cardinality so LRU is thrashing.
sara: we intentionally added user_id to namespace to reduce cross-tenant collisions. maybe we over-normalized.
michael: repro steps for others: 1) replay request batch from ticket 3201 2) run with current prod config 3) watch prefixcache_miss_rate and kv_load_time.
jamie: reproduction confirmed in local replay. Start log snippet:
```
[09:11:23] prefixcache: miss key="pref:usr:abcd..." -> miss
[09:11:23] kvstore: fetch latency=12ms
[09:11:23] prefixcache: insert key="pref:usr:xyz..." size=1
[09:11:24] prefixcache: evict key="pref:old:..." reason=LRU
```
deepak: mitigation options: rollback normalization change, increase cache capacity, switch eviction policy to size-aware LFU, add aggressive warmup for customer hot prefixes, or throttle small noisy clients.
luis: operationally we should rollback the normalization PR ASAP for lowest blast radius.
sara: preparing rollback PR now.
jamie: proposing short-term mitigations while rollback in flight: 1) increase prefixcache.max_entries by 50% on us-west-2 2) enable prefixcache.preload=true to start background warmup for active prefixes 3) add temporary route-level sticky to keep warm caches on same hosts. any objections?
michael: fine with increase and preload. sticky routing needs infra approval (could impact autoscaling).
ops-bot: executing config change: prefixcache.max_entries=1.5 -> applied to us-west-2 canary group at 09:28 UTC.
jamie: rolled rollback of key-normalization at 09:34 (PR revert merged). monitoring...
jamie: p95 in canary dropped from +300ms to +60ms within 6 minutes. top-line: rollback + cache bump looks effective.
support-bot: updated tickets #3201 #3202 with rollback mitigation and timeline. customers notified with ETA for full fix.
deepak: follow-ups: we need long-term fixes: - add histogram for normalized_key_entropy - per-tenant key-cardinality alerts - automated prefix warmup job seeded from recent traces - review default eviction policy to LFU-or-size and TTL tuning
luis: also add tests in staging that exercise higher-cardinality key shapes to catch this earlier.
sara: agreed. I'll own a postmortem draft and root cause notes.
jamie: created follow-up INF ticket INF-487 (https://redwood.internal/INF-487) to: "cache telemetry: normalized_key_entropy, miss_rate per prefix, warmup job, eviction metrics".
michael: small code patch to key-normalization to gate user_id inclusion behind feature flag so we can A/B rollout.
jamie: new alert thresholds: prefixcache_miss_rate > 40% for 5m -> page. Also added p99 latency composite alert for text-gen routes.
support-bot: customers marked as 'affected' and support team triaging escalations.
sara: postmortem will include timeline, RCA, mitigation steps, and action items. planning meeting at 16:00 UTC today.
jamie: thanks team. lesson: watch effective key cardinality after normalization changes and add canary traffic that stresses hot prefixes. :thumbsup:
luis: adding note: consider sticky caches + gradual rollout on future normalization changes to avoid cold-thrash.
ops-bot: note: config changes logged (audit id c-8923).
jamie: closing thread for now, will update INF-487 and PM notes.
